caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6/CAMP/dbAMP aggregate entry rows were checked against Table 2 and Fig 1, but linked packet rows do not expose an exact database sequence field and some CAMP rows contain extra database-only target/MBC entries outside this paper; supported primary-source subsets remain recorded and unsupported entry-level claims stay source_conflict.

DBAASP exact percent haemolysis rows were compared to Fig 9A and paper prose; local material supports the RBC haemolysis trend and concentration surface, but exact database percentages are figure-derived rather than structured primary table values, so they remain source_conflict.

Primary Table 2 spells Staphylococcus as Stahylococcus in the source XML/PDF; database rows normalize the organism name. MIC value matching used row/strain/value locators and preserves the source spelling caveat.
S1 File text/PDF and S1 Movie were reopened; supplementary material contains MD methods, primers, and figures, not additional structured activity/database rows that change the worker-4 adjudication.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/worker-6 source re-review closed the prior framework-test blocker for buffalo CATHL4s. Table 2 MIC database rows are corrected to source row/column locators, figure-derived and aggregate database-only claims are preserved as cautions, and the paper is publication-grade accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean.
